question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a blue ball, Bob has a silver ball, Claire has a pink ball, Dave has a brown ball, and Eve has a white ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Dave and Bob swap balls. Then, Claire and Eve swap balls. Then, Alice and Dave swap balls. Then, Alice and Claire swap balls. Finally, Eve and Bob swap balls. At the end of the game, Claire has the
Options:
(A) blue ball
(B) silver ball
(C) pink ball
(D) brown ball
(E) white ball
solution:
Ball colors in every row are listed in player order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: blue, silver, pink, brown, white
1. Dave ↔ Bob: blue, brown, pink, silver, white
2. Claire ↔ Eve: blue, brown, white, silver, pink
3. Alice ↔ Dave: silver, brown, white, blue, pink
4. Alice ↔ Claire: white, brown, silver, blue, pink
5. Eve ↔ Bob: white, pink, silver, blue, brown
Claire has the silver ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
